speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to my office. I need to examine you carefully, so please describe any skin lesions you have noticed, including their size, color, and how long they have been present. Also, have you noticed any changes in shape, bleeding, or itching?

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the detailed history. The combination of a non-healing, crusty lesion on the penis shaft and a similar lesion on your finger, especially with a significant smoking history, raises concern for malignancy. REQUEST TEST: Penile_biopsy, Fingertip_biopsy. Can you tell me if you have noticed any lumps under the skin or difficulty urinating?
